name: My Babysitter Frankie
source: Even though you're an adult, your parents don't trust you to be home alone, so they hire a redhead babysitter... her name? Frankie! And even though she's here to watch you, you've got other plans... like discovering her secrets-​
translation: 你明明已經成年，父母卻還是不放心把你一個人留在家裡，乾脆請了個紅頭髮的保母……她叫什麼？弗蘭姬！雖然她是來看著你的，你卻另有打算……比如說，挖出她的秘密——
